mcq.q: You switch embedding models with the same dimensions. You must…
options: Re-embed the corpus and switch query encoder and index together
mcq.why: Different models produce incompatible vector spaces even at equal dimensions.

mcq.q: A stale queued update overwrote a newer document. The fix is…
mcq.why: Write only if the incoming version is newer than the stored one.

mcq.q: One tenant has 70% of traffic and lives on one shard. Best mitigation?
options: Dedicated shards/replicas sized for that tenant
mcq.why: Isolate and scale the hot tenant's own capacity.
